description: Case and input conventions shared by every fixture set in this directory.

case.model: Candidate model document, relative to the set directory.
case.baseline: Trusted accepted model the candidate is compared against; supplies change classification, freezes and version retirement.
case.patches: Step file whose 'patches' are applied, in order, to the state of the previous step; the result equals the file named by 'model'.
case.policy: Gate policy supplied as a trusted input.
case.acceptance: Acceptance records supplied as verified inputs.
case.evidence: Evidence records; their trust is established by verifying signatures per the set's evidenceTrust table, never assumed.
case.publishedBundles: Published contract bundles the adapter resolved; an absent list means no bundle was resolved.

expect.validation: 'valid' (no error finding), 'invalid' (at least one error finding) or null (not asserted).
expect.mustExclude: Finding codes that must not appear.
expect.mustIncludeFindings: Findings that must appear for a specific record, and for CONCERN_UNRESOLVED the specific concern.
expect.readiness: Readiness results for TaskSpec inputs: 'state', reasons that must and must not appear, and work-package content that must appear.
expect.changes: Comparison results: kinds and dimensions that must appear ('dimensionsAnyOf' needs at least one) and records named among the affected elements.
expect.invalidatedEvidence: Evidence ids the comparison must report as invalidated.
expect.acceptanceRequired: Whether the trusted policy requires acceptance of the change.
expect.stateAssertions: Members that must be absent from the resulting model; a tool never infers them.
expect.checks: Qualification checks that must give the stated result against the named fixture inputs.

hashes: Every hash is sha256 over canonical JSON: keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, undefined members dropped. An evidence input ref is "<recordKind>:<recordId>" and its hash is the canonical hash of that record in the named state.
signatures: Signature values in evidence records are placeholders. A qualification harness generates an Ed25519 key pair per run, substitutes its public key for the placeholder 'spki' of policy evidence key 'test-ci-runner', and signs every record whose evidenceTrust entry says signWith 'test-ci-runner' over its canonical JSON without the 'signature' member. Records marked 'unlisted-key' are signed with a second generated key the policy does not list. Records marked 'none' keep the placeholder.
